title: The Staff role dropdown groups roles into System Roles and Custom Roles
custom_preconds:
1. At least one custom role exists.
  2. You are logged in as an admin on the Staff page.
custom_steps:
1. Go to Settings > Staff.
  2. Find a user row and open their role selector.
  3. Look at the dropdown.
custom_expected: The dropdown has two groups: System Roles (the 11 built-in roles) and Custom Roles (the admin-created roles).
viu_status: Blocked-UI: the Edit Staff Member Role dropdown (System/Custom grouping) was not reached — the staff row click opened Manage-staff-enrollments. Follow-up: locate the Edit Staff Member action, open the Role selector.
evidence: 11 system roles confirmed in live roles list (was '12'). Grouping labels need live Staff page.
